note: Judged 2026-10-21 over current tags, units and records. Quote is item 1 of RFC 3101 Section 2.3's list ('Type-7 LSAs are identical to Type-5 LSAs except for the following'), the item dropped beside RFC3101-2.3-2. The positive checks h.Type, the stored LSA's wire type octet and the decoded header type are all 7. The negative originates the same route as Type-5: its type octet is 5, and its body is byte-identical to the Type-7 body, so only the type field separates them, as the list says.
